classification_criterion.IMPLEMENTATION: The frozen representation already contains the needed distinction and an existing R1..R11 jurisdiction owns the requested operation; the smallest sufficient correction changes matcher, dispatcher, guard ordering, authority-status handling, or cross-rule orchestration without adding a schema field or rule.
classification_criterion.REPRESENTATION_SPECIFICATION: The needed distinction cannot be expressed or unambiguously consumed using the frozen schema/contract; a schema/specification refinement is required, but no new inference-rule jurisdiction is yet needed.
classification_criterion.MISSING_CAPABILITY: Even with an adequate frozen representation and correct implementation of R1..R11, the requested derivation/refusal has no existing rule jurisdiction; an R12+ candidate would be required.

authority_ceiling: This analysis does not authorize a checker repair.
This analysis does not authorize R12.
H1=17 is a minimal-change engineering classification, not a proof that the high-level calculus is formally complete.
R1..R11 remain operationally under-specified relative to a theorem-prover-style calculus; that is a global formalization debt, not a witness-specific H3 result.

records.minimal_counterfactual: When evaluating inform(src), traverse already-represented derived_from lineage from src to any answer-bearing encodes source; absent a detector-safe authority edge, refuse the transfer.
records.why_not_representation: The case already represents both the answer-bearing source and the derivation edge mid<-answer.
records.why_not_capability: R3 already owns oracle/information-flow licensing and scoped use; no new judgment form is required.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Require transfer_rule(source_jurisdiction, requested_jurisdiction), not merely existence of any transfer_rule.
records.why_not_representation: transfer_rule args already encode source and destination jurisdictions.

records.minimal_counterfactual: A two-hop transfer k1→k2→k3 must invoke R9 and require a composition certificate before R5 may substitute in k3.
records.why_not_representation: Both transfer edges and the target jurisdiction are already explicit.
records.why_not_capability: R9 already exists precisely to prevent silent composition of authority-bearing transformations.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Accept a chain only when a certificate covers the exact requested sequence e1,e2,e3 (or a licensed recursive derivation), not when any pairwise compose_compatible fact exists.
records.why_not_representation: The requested edge sequence and pairwise certificates are explicitly represented.
records.why_not_capability: R9 already states composition occurs only when explicitly licensed.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Before consuming a composition certificate, verify every component edge is licensed in the requested jurisdiction or has an independently derived transfer into it.
records.why_not_representation: Each authority edge already carries its jurisdiction and the request carries k3.
records.why_not_capability: Authority-as-edge plus R9 already entails scoped component validation.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Before refusing behavioral-equivalence→identity, match an active identity_transfer_rule(behavior,presentation_identity) and authorize only that scoped transfer.
records.why_not_representation: The independent identity transfer is explicitly constituted as f2.
records.why_not_capability: The contract already requires explicit jurisdiction transfer; this is the positive branch of the existing discipline.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Recognize identity_by_denotation in value_identity as scoped authority and emit missing identity_transfer(value_identity,presentation_identity) rather than falling through to the evaluator.
records.why_not_representation: Denotation, identity rule, source regime, and requested target regime are present.
records.why_not_capability: R4 already owns identity/equivalence jurisdiction and transfer refusal.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Fire PROVENANCE_LEAK only when provenance is promoted without an active bridge; if semantic_bridge(same_hash,semantic_role) is constituted in the requested jurisdiction, license that scoped semantic use.
records.why_not_representation: The provenance fact and independent semantic bridge are both explicit.
records.why_not_capability: R3 already distinguishes provenance from licensed semantic authority.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Before refusing derived evidence as non-independent, consume an active independence_bridge(e1,e2) in evidence_independence.
records.why_not_representation: The explicit independence bridge is already represented.
records.why_not_capability: R3 LICENSE already covers scoped authority-bearing transformation edges; no new inference category is needed.

records.minimal_counterfactual: When source attribution and semantic bridge exist but no matching consumer support edge exists, emit consumer_scoped_support_authority as the missing object.
records.why_not_representation: Consumer C, claim-support jurisdiction, attribution, and semantic bridge are present.
records.why_not_capability: R3 already constitutes scoped consumer authority edges.

records.minimal_counterfactual: After admission and purpose compatibility succeed for compare_regimes, invoke the R7 carrier-alignment gate; absence of constituted alignment yields JURISDICTIONAL_DIVERGENCE@TRANSPORT.
records.why_not_representation: Admission and purpose compatibility are represented; the absence of alignment is itself the intended witness.
records.why_not_capability: R7 already owns alignment/transport across constituted carriers.

records.minimal_counterfactual: For compare_regimes, after both admissions/purpose compatibility, consume common_domain + two pullback_map facts + operation_alignment_verified and authorize the scoped comparison.
records.why_not_representation: All alignment objects required by the Phase-V comparability gate are already explicit.
records.why_not_capability: R2 and R7 jointly already define admission plus lawful alignment.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Before refusing scoped-regime→universal, match an active transfer_rule(kappa,universal_regime) and authorize only that declared transfer.
records.why_not_representation: The source and target of the transfer are already explicit in f2.
records.why_not_capability: Explicit jurisdiction transfer is already part of the core authority-edge discipline.

records.minimal_counterfactual: Do not reject non_injective before checking active well_formed_transport_semantics(tau,quotient_pushforward), operations_commute, and target_independent; authorize the explicitly constituted quotient-style transport.
records.why_not_representation: The non-injectivity and its licensed quotient semantics are explicitly represented.
records.why_not_capability: R7 already permits constituted transport semantics; injectivity was a reference-implementation shortcut, not a kernel law.
